subject: lubu_riding
prompt:
STYLE: 2D hand-drawn action comic game art, Chinese ink-wash inspired, bold dark-brown ink outlines (#2B1D16), flat colors with one hard cel-shadow tone, subtle rice-paper texture, slightly chibi proportions (head-to-body 1:3), strong readable silhouettes, ink splatter accents, top-left light source, top-down three-quarter view at 45 degrees, Late Eastern Han dynasty China setting, original designs, suitable for a top-down action roguelike.
Original Lu Bu warlord in dark iron-bronze armor, red cloak and two pheasant-feather plumes, on crimson Han warhorse. Strict 3x2 sheet: mounted idle, mounted charge, mounted turning crescent halberd strike; separate rider seated with transparent space under legs (NO horse), separate riderless crimson horse without saddle, separate Han saddle and harness. No ground. Parts are references for bone assembly.
Delivery layout: 3 columns x 2 rows. Every cell contains exactly its stated object, optically centered with at least 10% transparent padding. Objects never cross cell boundaries. Use uniform logical cell dimensions. No visible grid, borders or labels. True transparent PNG except ground tiles which must be opaque. Keep rice-paper grain inside painted shapes only; completely transparent empty space, no paper backdrop or matte. Original designs only, no imitation, no watermark or logo. Reference image is a style and identity guide; preserve design language while making only the requested new asset. Target production game sprites, fixed top-left light.
